title: Convexity from order: a theory of faces and generalized separation
summary: It is known that any convex cone in a general vector space is the positive cone of a preorder compatible with the vector space, and that any convex set is an affine slice of a convex cone. We therefore treat convex sets order-theoretically, as affine slices of positive cones. We find that faces are sets of strong minima, and we generalize functionals to oriented maps valued in arbitrary ordered vector spaces.
